profile.headline: Full Stack Software Engineer | Security+ | C#/.NET | JavaScript | Python | React.js | SQL | Professional | Life-Long Learner | U.S. Marine Corps Veteran
profile.summary:
As a military veteran, I bring a unique perspective to the technology field, leveraging my experience in leadership, teamwork, and adaptability to deliver results in fast-paced environments. I am a self-motivated learner who has honed my skills in software development, with a particular focus on creating secure web applications.

My passion for technology goes beyond just learning new things, as I am eager to share my knowledge and mentor others in the field. With excellent communication skills in both English and Spanish, I have effectively collaborated with diverse teams, facilitated training sessions, and presented technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.

In complex situations, I thrive on finding innovative solutions and utilizing my outstanding problem-solving abilities to overcome challenges. I have a proven track record of delivering high-quality results in fast-paced environments, whether working independently or as part of a team.

My career ambitions are to continue to grow as an individual and contribute to the success of a dynamic organization. I am excited to bring my unique skillset, military experience, and passion for technology to a role that will allow me to continue learning, innovate, and make a positive impact.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
• Employed optimization techniques to improve customer-facing web applications, resulting in increased order volume and enhanced user experience.
• Conducted comprehensive testing and debugging of customer-facing web applications using a range of debugging tools, including Chrome DevTools and Visual Studio Debugger.
• Utilized a combination of .NET Core, C#, Knockout.js, CSS, and HTML to develop and maintain web applications.
• Implemented AGILE/SCRUM methodologies, including daily stand-ups, to promote effective communication and collaboration.
• Utilized Git and Azure DevOps for repository management and source control.
• Implemented effective process improvement methodologies aimed at reducing waste, costs, and enhancing application efficiency.

positions.title: Full Stack Software Engineer
positions.description:
A web-based immersive cyber security training platform designed to engage all ages while providing educators/administrators robust controls to tailor training content for any user.

• Developed a web-based immersive cyber security training platform using React.js, .NET/C#, and SQL.
• Designed and constructed UI components to create a clean and easy-to-use interface.
• Created RESTful APIs to provide UI access to database information.
• Conducted thorough debugging and testing of customer-facing web applications using debugging tools like Visual Studio Debugger and Chrome DevTools.
• Integrated third-party React.js libraries to enhance functionality and user experience.
• Managed repositories and source control using GitHub and Git.
• Practiced AGILE/SCRUM methodologies and participated in daily stand-ups to foster effective communication and collaboration.
• Implemented process improvement methodologies to reduce costs, waste, and improve application efficiency.

positions.title: Geek Squad Manager
positions.description:
• Oversaw technical competency, proficiency, and professionalism of a 7-member team performing numerous IT/computer-related functions, fostering growth by conducting OJT sessions
• Provided work direction, training, and development for a group of Diverse Agents assembling and delivering customer PCs according to specifications; possessing adept knowledge and skills in Windows operating systems
• Analyzed and evaluated both financial and Agent performance to create plans that drove Precinct and Autotech Bay performance and overall Services revenue

positions.title: Transportation Supervisor / Sergeant
positions.description:
• Led, coached, and developed 12 employees while overseeing performance and professionalism
• Received, approved, and coordinated the delivery of 100+ heavy-cargo deliveries to support large-scale training exercises; achieving the safe and efficient delivery of over $10M in supplies and equipment

positions.title: Specialized Security Supervisor
positions.description:
• Offered courteous and effective assistance to both employees and visitors while consistently demonstrating exceptional professionalism.
• Prioritized the provision of top-notch customer service while ensuring the safety, security, and well-being of all individuals present on the premises.
•  Enforced all applicable rules, regulations, policies, and procedures, and remained vigilant and proactive in responding to emergency situations requiring security assistance.
•  Demonstrated strong communication skills by clearly conveying information and providing guidance to individuals.
• Maintained a professional and approachable demeanor at all times, fostering a welcoming and secure environment.
• Collaborated effectively with team members and superiors to optimize security procedures and protocols.
• Conducted thorough inspections and patrols of the premises, promptly identifying and addressing potential safety or security concerns.
